name: @agentic-toolkit/editing
description: The editing container: one owner of the draft, the Save button and the unsaved-changes guard for every editable surface.
comment:exports: ONE entry, on purpose. The bound controls live in src/controls.tsx and no export key reaches them, so there is no import path that produces a control outside a container — that unreachability IS the compile-time enforcement. Do not add a wildcard here. `development` → src for `next dev` (HMR, no build/restart); prod (NODE_ENV=production) skips it → dist.
